SELECT a.id, a.name, c.name AS categoryName, a.reason, u.nick_name AS applicantName, u.phone AS phone, a.status, DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(a.review_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS reviewTime, a.reject_reason AS rejectReason, a.team_id AS teamId FROM team_apply a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.applicant_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN team_category c ON a.category_id = c.id
AND a.status = #{status}
AND (a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY a.status ASC, a.create_time DESC
